title: Verdict
description: Result of a local lookup for one IP address (FR-002, FR-003).

ip.description: Canonical address: dotted quad for IPv4 (IPv4-mapped IPv6 is unwrapped), RFC 5952 for IPv6.

risk.description: 100 · (1 − Π(1 − w·c·decay)), with the category-only cap applied, rounded to 0.1.

level.description: Taken from the rounded risk and the thresholds of the scoring configuration.

categories.description: Distinct category names of the category signals, sorted (e.g. ["cloud", "tor"]).

reasons.description: One entry per (code, source), sorted by contribution descending, then code, then source.

prefix.description: The matched prefix in CIDR notation.

contribution.description: Share of risk. The contributions of all reasons add up to risk exactly.

shippable.description: False when the source licence forbids redistribution or commercial use (FR-015).

network.description: From the most specific routed prefix. null means unknown (FR-022).

behaviorHistoryIncomplete.description: True when behavior data that could affect this evaluation time has been deleted by retention.
